name: Popover
summary: Non-modal trigger-owned floating surface with content-derived semantics, optional arrow and title, portable and native Web open states, dismissal, and natural focus behavior.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Floating panel that owns surface, border, shadow, and visibility motion.

anatomy.name: arrow
anatomy.description: Optional arrow pointing toward the trigger.

states.name: open
states.description: Visible state controlled by the portable modifier or the native Web Popover API.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: The panel is hidden by default and becomes visible through the portable modifier or native Web popover state.

behavior.name: triggerRelationship
behavior.description: A native Button exposes expanded state and references the panel. Capable Web targets may use popovertarget; aria-haspopup is added only when the content-derived role requires it.

behavior.name: contentSemantics
behavior.description: Popover has no default ARIA role. Targets select native or ARIA semantics from the content and provide a name only when that role requires one.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: The popover should close on Escape, outside interaction, or repeated trigger activation.

behavior.name: focusManagement
behavior.description: Non-modal popovers preserve natural tab order without a trap. Passive content may leave focus on the trigger; targets that move focus inside restore it on keyboard dismissal.

behavior.name: stateOwnership
behavior.description: Targets may implement controlled open or uncontrolled default-open state while preserving the same trigger, dismissal, and focus meaning.

behavior.name: optionalArrow
behavior.description: The decorative arrow may be rendered or omitted independently from Popover content and behavior; it never carries meaning or becomes the positioning authority.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls whether the popover panel is visible; trigger state, dismissal, focus restoration, and positioning remain target behavior.

properties.name: showArrow
properties.description: Shows the decorative arrow that visually relates the surface to its trigger; false omits it or hides it natively without changing Popover behavior.

accessibility: Use Popover for concise non-modal supplemental content; use Modal or Drawer when background interaction must be blocked.
Use a native Button and connect it to the panel with aria-controls/aria-expanded or native popovertarget behavior.
Do not force role=dialog or aria-haspopup=dialog; choose semantics from the actual content.
Close on Escape and outside interaction.
Do not trap focus in a non-modal popover.
Restore trigger focus after keyboard dismissal when focus moved into the panel.
Use a dialog pattern if the panel contains a complex form or long interaction.

web.notes: Portable class state and native :popover-open styling are implemented in components/css/layout.css; the consuming target owns content semantics, positioning, collision, dismissal, and focus behavior.
